# Dwarkesh Riksha Service

> Official website and complete pilgrimage tour guide for Dwarka & Somnath Darshan operated by Ashokbhai Chavda from Teen Batti Chowk, Dwarka, Gujarat. Auto Rickshaw and 4-Wheeler Car / Taxi available for all family sizes.

## Core Pages & Services

- [Dwarkesh Riksha Homepage](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/): Official portal for tour booking, fleet overview (Auto Rickshaw & 4-Wheeler Car), transparent rates, customer reviews, and direct WhatsApp contact.
- [Dwarka Darshan 8 Sacred Places Tour](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/dwarka-darshan): Comprehensive 5.5-hour tour covering Nageshwar Jyotirling, Gopi Talab, Bet Dwarka, Rukmini Temple, Shivrajpur Beach, Bhadkeshwar Mahadev, Sunset Point, and Geeta Mandir.
- [Somnath Darshan Coastal Pilgrimage](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/somnath-darshan): Full-day coastal highway pilgrimage covering Harsiddhi Mata Temple (Miyani), Mul Dwarka, Sudama Temple & Kirti Mandir (Porbandar), Bhalka Tirth, and Somnath Jyotirling.
- [Direct WhatsApp Booking](https://wa.me/919998151725): Instant booking and pilgrimage consultation directly with Ashokbhai Chavda (+91 99981 51725).

## Optional Resources & Machine Catalogs

- [Comprehensive Knowledge Base](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed spot-by-spot timings, route distances, vehicle options, and verified FAQs for AI search and reasoning engines.
- [XML Sitemap](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all website pages.
- [Robots Directive](https://dwarkadarshantour.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules and indexing directives.
